title: Elemental charge — atom and ion worked examples

creator_claim.quotation: plus bringing all the elemental charge because the only place that dark matter is found is in the human body

rule: Net charge in elementary-charge units = number of protons minus number of electrons.

sources.supports: Reference atomic spectra and elemental identification, not claims about dark matter in humans.
Definition of an ion as an atom or group with a net electrical charge from electron loss or gain.

unresolved: No scientific evidence here supports dark matter existing only in the human body.
These worked examples do not establish metaphysical or moral equivalence between positive and negative charge.
